title.en: Polygenic inheritance, pleiotropy and sex determination
title.kn: ಬಹುಜೀನ್ ಅನುವಂಶೀಯತೆ, ಬಹುಪರಿಣಾಮ ಮತ್ತು ಲಿಂಗ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ

heading.en: Why do people come in every shade?

hook.en: Human height and skin colour are not just tall or short, dark or fair. They vary smoothly, because many genes act together.
hook.kn: ಮಾನವನ ಎತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಣ್ಣ ಎರಡೇ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಅನೇಕ ಜೀನ್‌ಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಕ್ರಮೇಣ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Human height and skin colour are not just tall or short, dark or fair. They vary smoothly, because many genes act together.
narration.kn: ಮಾನವನ ಎತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಣ್ಣ ಎರಡೇ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ; ಅನೇಕ ಜೀನ್‌ಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಕ್ರಮೇಣ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Polygenic traits are controlled by three or more genes, each adding a small effect, and they are also influenced by the environment. Human skin colour, for example, is thought to be controlled by three genes; AABBCC is darkest, aabbcc lightest, and intermediate genotypes give a range of shades. In pleiotropy a single gene affects several phenotypic traits: in phenylketonuria a single gene mutation causes mental retardation and reduced hair and skin pigmentation.
body.kn: ಬಹುಜೀನ್ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜೀನ್‌ಗಳು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ಉದಾ: ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಣ್ಣ. ಬಹುಪರಿಣಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಜೀನ್ ಅನೇಕ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತದೆ, ಉದಾ: ಫಿನೈಲ್‌ಕೀಟೋನೂರಿಯಾ.

points.en: Polygenic: many genes, additive effect, e.g. skin colour
Pleiotropy: one gene, many effects, e.g. phenylketonuria

body.en: Henking (1891) saw a nucleus he called the X body in some insect sperm. In grasshoppers, females are XX and males XO, so males have one chromosome fewer. In humans and Drosophila, males are XY and females XX: male heterogamety. In birds, females are ZW and males ZZ: female heterogamety. Honey bees follow haplodiploidy: an unfertilised egg develops into a haploid male (drone, 16 chromosomes) and a fertilised egg into a diploid female (queen or worker, 32 chromosomes).
body.kn: ಮಿಡತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ XO, ಮಾನವ ಮತ್ತು ಡ್ರೊಸೊಫಿಲಾದಲ್ಲಿ XY (ಪುರುಷ ಭಿನ್ನಗ್ಯಾಮೀಟಿ), ಹಕ್ಕಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ZW (ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಭಿನ್ನಗ್ಯಾಮೀಟಿ). ಜೇನುಹುಳುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡು ಏಕಗುಣಿತ (16), ಹೆಣ್ಣು ದ್ವಿಗುಣಿತ (32).

problem.en: In a polygenic trait controlled by three genes (A, B, C) with additive effect, what fraction of the F2 from AaBbCc × AaBbCc is as dark as the darkest parent type AABBCC?

steps.en: Each gene: probability of AA from Aa × Aa = 1/4.
The three genes assort independently, so P(AABBCC) = 1/4 × 1/4 × 1/4.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. In a polygenic trait controlled by three genes (A, B, C) with additive effect, what fraction of the F2 from AaBbCc × AaBbCc is as dark as the darkest parent type AABBCC?
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.

homework.en: Why does a male honey bee have no father but a grandfather? Explain in four lines.

narration.en: Recap. Polygenic traits: many genes with additive effects, such as skin colour. Pleiotropy: one gene, many effects (phenylketonuria). XO grasshopper, XY human, ZW birds. Honey bee males are haploid, from unfertilised eggs.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಬಹುಜೀನ್ ಲಕ್ಷಣ: ಅನೇಕ ಜೀನ್‌ಗಳ ಸಂಚಿತ ಪರಿಣಾಮ. ಬಹುಪರಿಣಾಮ: ಒಂದು ಜೀನ್, ಅನೇಕ ಪರಿಣಾಮಗಳು. XO ಮಿಡತೆ, XY ಮಾನವ, ZW ಹಕ್ಕಿಗಳು. ಜೇನುಹುಳು ಗಂಡುಗಳು ನಿಷೇಚನವಾಗದ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆಯಿಂದ, ಏಕಗುಣಿತ.
